replace the operator, rechargeAddress, ethBackAddress, pauser and blacklister at any time, with no delay.
whitelist or remove callers and set each caller's allowance and refill interval, with no delay.
blacklist any address, blocking it from transferring, receiving, depositing or redeeming.
configure minters and their allowances. A minter can mint wBETH to any address with no ETH backing, up to its allowance.
pause and unpause the token. While paused, transfers, deposits (mint) and redemption requests (burn) all revert.

entries.name: UnwrapTokenV1ETH
entries.description: Redemption queue for wBETH. The token contract records a claim here when a holder burns wBETH; the claim becomes payable once ETH has been allocated to it (automatically on request if the queue already holds enough, otherwise by the operator) and the lock time of 10d has passed. Only ETH sent by the token operator or the rechargeAddress counts toward allocation; the contract has no way to pull ETH from validators. 134 claims have been recorded so far. The operator can also send any surplus ETH back to the ethBackAddress.

rechargeAddress.description: Address allowed to top the contract up with ETH for pending claims.

ethBackAddress.description: Address that receives surplus ETH when the operator calls moveToBackAddress().

lockTime.description: Time between a redemption request and the earliest claim. Set by the operator, floor of 2 days.

lockTimeSeconds.description: Raw copy of lockTime, in seconds, for the project page to spell out.

entries.name: ExchangeRateUpdater
entries.description: Rate-limited relay that is the token's registered oracle. Whitelisted callers write the wBETH exchange rate through it, and each caller has an allowance that caps the cumulative absolute change it may push; the allowance refills linearly over the caller's interval. This is the only bound on the exchange rate anywhere in the system, and it can be bypassed by the token owner repointing the oracle.

directlyReceivedPermissions.description: set the exchange rate used for minting and redemption. The token itself only requires the new rate to be at least 1e18; any tighter bound comes from the oracle contract.

callers.description: Addresses allowed to push a new exchange rate through this contract.

callerLimits.description: Per-caller cap on the cumulative absolute rate change (1e18 scale) and the number of seconds over which that allowance refills.

tokenContract.description: The token whose exchange rate this contract writes.

entries.name: wBETH
entries.description: Liquid staking token (wBETH) built on Circle's FiatToken code with a staking layer on top. Anyone can mint by sending ETH to deposit(), receiving ETH ÷ exchangeRate tokens; the ETH stays in this contract until the operator moves it to the ethReceiver. Redemption is requestWithdrawEth(): the tokens are burned at the current rate and an ETH claim is recorded in the unwrap contract. Neither path is open while the token is paused or the caller is blacklisted. The exchange rate is a single storage value written by the oracle address, bounded only to be at least 1e18. Configured minters can additionally mint tokens with no ETH backing, up to their allowance; 3175308537299494959722021 is the live supply.

minters.description: Addresses allowed to mint wBETH without depositing ETH, within the allowance the masterMinter set.

oracle.description: The only address that can write the wBETH:ETH exchange rate.

ethReceiver.description: Address that receives deposited ETH when the operator calls moveToStakingAddress(). The staking that follows happens off-chain from this address.

exchangeRate.description: ETH per wBETH, scaled by 1e18. Written by the oracle; read by deposit() and requestWithdrawEth().

_UNWRAP_ETH_ADDRESS.description: Hard-coded unwrap contract that receives redemption claims; changing it needs an implementation upgrade.

receivedPermissions.description: mint unbacked wBETH to a registered hot wallet and transfer tokens held here to a hot wallet.

entries.name: OperatorWallet
entries.description: Binance's minting wallet. It is the only configured wBETH minter and its allowance is unlimited. Its operator or owner can mint wBETH to itself or to a registered hot wallet with no ETH deposited on-chain; this is how wBETH is issued to users who wrap BETH on the exchange, and it accounts for nearly all of the supply. The owner can also add hot wallets, pause the wallet, and execute arbitrary calls from it, which lets it mint to any address.

directlyReceivedPermissions.description: mint wBETH to itself or to any address with no ETH backing, up to its minter allowance, and burn its own balance.

hotWallets.description: Binance exchange wallets that minted wBETH can be sent to.

receivedPermissions.description: mint unbacked wBETH to any address (through execTransaction), add or remove hot wallets, replace the operator, pause the wallet, and withdraw anything the wallet holds.
